verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a client-side rendering library, but a machine-readable API description (OpenAPI or a library equivalent such as a downloadable typedoc/JSON spec) is still a fair ask, so the axis applies. The probe found every OpenAPI/Swagger candidate path returning 404, and the evidence documents no downloadable spec. The TypeScript IntelliSense claim and the llms.txt docs index are adjacent features, not a published API spec, so they earn no credit.
